slice_binding.qualification: Provider-contract evidence based on an offline CLI return code, not an independently observed exit code.

design_values.envelope_limit_mm: 38.0 diameter x 18.0 high including 2 mm raised front hub
design_values.grip: Six equally spaced R8 scallops at center radius 24.75 mm; nominal minimum grip diameter 33.5 mm; nominal 1.0 mm exposed-edge rounds; twelve 1.2 mm diameter x 0.35 mm raised dots at radius 13.5 mm.
design_values.socket: Concentric blind D socket, 10.0 mm deep, derived from a 6.00 mm round boundary and 5.20 mm across-flat shaft with 0.20 mm radial and 0.20 mm flat clearance; constructed as R3.2 clipped at x>=-2.4 mm. No set screw, insert, taper or keyway.
design_values.tolerance: Proposed ±0.25 mm applies to non-mating prototype dimensions only; D-socket design values are not measured fit values.

geometry_observations.approximation_note: Nominal rounds and circular features are tessellated approximations.

preparation_observations.orientation: Repaired mesh was rotated 180 degrees about X and translated to Z=0, placing the blind D-socket opening upward (+Z). This protects the opening but puts the raised front hub at the build-plate side.
preparation_observations.support_consequence: The 2 mm hub can elevate surrounding front-face regions and produce broad underside overhangs. Actual nominal toolpaths include support, so zero support is not claimed.
